title: Light Novel Source Manifest v0
description: Input manifest for LIGHT_NOVEL_INGESTION/v0: an ordered collection of controlled plain-text source documents for one story and one discourse stream. Identifiers are caller-supplied and opaque. A document may be a chapter, a prologue, a side story or any other unit; the contract does not use the word. `path` is adapter metadata and never identity. JSON Schema is a notation here, not a storage commitment.

source_language.description: Language tag of the source text (for example ja, en, zh-Hant). Recorded as metadata; the adapter does not interpret it.

Id.description: Same rule as the Canonical Story Id: opaque, stable, no semantics. Must not be derived from a filename or a source-language name.

order.description: Position of the document in reading order. Unique within the manifest. Values need not be contiguous.

path.description: Location of the source file, relative to the source root, with forward slashes. Adapter metadata only.

expected_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact source bytes. A mismatch is a hard failure.
